findings.issue: 何か as the indefinite pronoun 'something' is standardly read なにか; なんか is a colloquial contraction and should not be the default reading in this neutral/reflective sentence. Romaji 'nanka...' inherits the same error.
findings.current: なんかいみがあるのだろうか。
findings.suggested: なにかいみがあるのだろうか。

findings.issue: Token 何 is given reading なん; as the pronoun 何(か) 'something' the standard reading is なに (なにか). なんか is a colloquial variant, misleading as the taught reading.
